skills.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Present Self[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c] applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] reaches 300 points, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c] becomes available.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] is consumed and [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] becomes available. The arrow applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Present Self[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Present Self[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5[/c] each applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
In [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Hold Breath[/c], continuously consuming STA. When [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the [c=Highlight]Hold Breath[/c] state and thrusts forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2[/c].
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4[/c] instead.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c]. 
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] and consume STA and 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] to gain 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
[c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3[/c] apply [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
The [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c] cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] within a short period.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Frostblight
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
Casting this skill enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c], which now restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].

While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c]:

[c=Title]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c]
While on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], removing the targets' [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

[c=Title]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c]
While in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], removing the targets' [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c].

skills.name: Foreclaiming
skills.description:
[c=Title]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c]
[c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] becomes available after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast this skill, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c], remove 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c]. Then, enter [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c] and restore 50 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] applies 4 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on hit.
Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] does not consume Resonance Energy.

[c=Title]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] can be cast via the following ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] and release to cast [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]. If Hiyuki has 3 points of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], consume all [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c]. Otherwise, this cast does not consume [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].
- Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] periodically. Release [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]. If no [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] is consumed when [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] will also be cast automatically when [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] depletes. 
Hiyuki deals [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Each point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c], and ends [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c].

skills.name: Frostedge
skills.description:
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
In [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], casting this skill restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c]. Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].
In [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Snowlight Blessing
skills.description: Glacio DMG dealt by nearby Resonators other than Hiyuki in the team is Amplified by 20% against targets affected by [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] for 20s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Hiyuki can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Everfrost Dominion
skills.description:
[c=Title]Glacio Bite[/c]
- While Hiyuki is in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c]. Every time a new stack of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] is inflicted on a target, an instance of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is triggered based on that enemy's current [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] stack limit. [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] can be inflicted on [c=Highlight]frozen[/c] targets. [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] is also considered [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] and [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is also considered [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe DMG[/c].
- When [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c], consume 10 stacks and trigger [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c] once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] into [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c], all enemies' [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] stacks are cleared.

[c=Title]Present Self[/c]
Hiyuki starts in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], casting certain skills restores [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].

[c=Title]Foreclaimed Self[/c]
Hiyuki enters [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] through certain attacks.

[c=Title]Iai Stance[/c]
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c], performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c]:
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] after casting any [c=Highlight]Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self[/c] other than [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Frostedge[/c].
- Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] within a certain period after casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c].
Hiyuki may enter [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c] while airborne. Upon entering the [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c], Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c] ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Iai[/c]
Within a certain period after entering [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] and consume 100 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] is cast, if Hiyuki has [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c], consume 1 point of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] to inflict 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on hit, and gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c].

[c=Title]Dedication[/c]
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Frostedge[/c] restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c] enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c], which now additionally restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c]. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

[c=Title]Frostheart[/c]
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] is restored while casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c], or when [c=Highlight]Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self[/c] other than [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] hits the target.

[c=Title]Frostharden Iai[/c]
[c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] grants 3 points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c].

[c=Title]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c]
[c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] stacks up to 3 times.
Each time [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] is consumed through [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c].

[c=Title]Snowforged Blade[/c]
[c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] stacks up to 3 times.
Each time [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] is cast, gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].

skills.name: Fine Snow
skills.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] or [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c], Hiyuki gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]. [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c] stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

skills.name: Ephemeral Realm
skills.description: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], restore 1 point.

sequences.name: Springless
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c] are increased by 120%.

[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c] now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting  [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5[/c].

Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2[/c], which now inflict [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

sequences.name: To Burn Cold in Silence
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c]'s DMG Multiplier is increased by 125%.

Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Realm[/c]'s effect becomes the following one:
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore 3 points of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].

Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, the following effects are triggered once:
- While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], restore 3 points points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c].
- Reset the Cooldown of 2 charges of [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c].
- Restore an additional 50 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] for the next 2 casts of [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

sequences.name: No Self, No Bound
sequences.description:
Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Fine Snow[/c] gains the following effect:
2s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c] in this way.

The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] are increased by 160%.

At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] is increased by 488%.

sequences.name: Like Reeds on Tides
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c] increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

Restore 18% of Max HP while casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

sequences.name: Vessel of Thousand Wishes
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c] are increased by 80%.

sequences.name: Into a Night Without End
sequences.description:
The Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] and [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] is increased by 500%.

At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the effect "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier" changes to "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier."
At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
At 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the total [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by 25%.

skills.name: Sword to Carve My Forms
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Following [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c] Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on targets hit and summon [c=Highlight]Sword of Divinity's Shadow[/c].
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Divinity's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Cartethyia[/c] 
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and summoning [c=Highlight]Sword of Discord's Shadow[/c]. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Discord's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c]
Release [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], also considered [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after the [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c] recalls all [c=Highlight]Sword Shadows[/c]. Based on the types and number of [c=Highlight] Sword Shadows[/c] recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding [c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c], [c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c], and [c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Cartethyia[/c]
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Sword to Bear Their Names
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c]
Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and inflicting 2 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. Can be performed in mid-air.
Following [c=Highlight]Cartethyia - Resonance Skill[/c], summon [c=Highlight]Sword of Virtue's Shadow[/c].
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Virtue's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

skills.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c]
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] transforms into [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], unlocking new moves and entering the [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] clears all [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c].
As [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] instantly trigger 1 instance of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG and reduce the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] attacks restore [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. When [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c].

When [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c]. When in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]:
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4[/c] will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] resistance to interruption increases. 
[c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.

When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]: 
[c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c].
[c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.
 
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]:
When casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c] and [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] or after [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] deals damage, raise the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
[c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.
 
[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] will transform back to [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] during [c=Highlight]quest dialogues[/c], [c=Highlight]environmental interaction animations[/c], or using [c=Highlight]Utilities[/c].
[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.
 
[c=Title]Avatar - Cartethyia[/c]
As [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], when [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2[/c] and temporarily transform back to [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c], which pauses the timer on [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c].
 
[c=Title]Avatar - Fleurdelys[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], casting Resonance Liberation as [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] performs [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c] without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], which resumes the timer on [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has 120 points of [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c], ends [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.description:
[c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] unlocks new moves when she transforms into [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c]:

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
While airborne, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
While airborne, casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] resets the cycle of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] again to cast Enhanced [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Upward Cut - Fleurdelys[/c].

[c=Title]Upward Cut - Fleurdelys[/c]
While [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] is on the ground, [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to cast this skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys[/c].
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 [/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c].
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c]
Following [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to ground targets, and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. 
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Rover: Aero is in the team, Rover: Aero additionally restores 25 [c=Highlight]Windstrings[/c] upon casting [c=Highlight]Omega Storm[/c].

skills.name: Wind's Indelible Imprint
skills.description: Targets with 1 to 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] take 30% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] and [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c]. Targets with more than 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] additionally take 10% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] and [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] for each stack of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] they have, up to 3 stacks.

sequences.name: Crown Destined by Fate
sequences.description:
Gain [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] that lasts for 10s when [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] or [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] attacks directly damage and defeat targets inflicted with [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c].
In the [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] state, upon defeating enemies, the next move that directly damages targets raises the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the targets to the highest count among the targets defeated. This will not exceed the current max [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stack limit. [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] is removed afterward and enters a 1s cooldown.
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] hits 30/60/90/120, [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] Crit. DMG is increased by 25% for 15s, up to 4 stacks. The duration of this effect does not reset upon gaining new stacks. After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], the increased Crit. DMG is removed.

sequences.name: Blade Broken by Tempest
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] increases the max stack limit of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on targets within a certain range by 3 stacks. The next attack that directly damages the target inflicts 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on all targets within a certain range and immediately triggers the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG on the targets hit once without consuming the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks.
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill are increased by 50% and the DMG Multiplier of her Mid-air Attack is increased by 200%.
After casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c], every 1 type of Sword Shadow recalled reduces the cooldown of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c] by 1s.

sequences.name: Prisoner Hanged in the Tower
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] now inflict 2 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets hit.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Sacrifice Made for Salvation
sequences.description: After Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c], [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c], [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], or[c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c], all Resonators in the team gain 20% DMG Bonus for all Attributes for 20s.

sequences.name: Hope Reshaped in Storms
sequences.description:
When [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] or [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] takes a fatal blow, they will not be downed by this instance of damage, but instead gain a Shield equal to 20% of [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.
The HP cost for casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] is reduced to 25% of Max HP.

sequences.name: Freedom Found in Storm's Wake
sequences.description:
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], raise the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the target hit to max. Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] no longer removes the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the target.
Within 30s after casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Sword to Call for Freedom[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], when any Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets with max stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c], immediately trigger the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG once.
The targets take 40% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c].

skills.name: Strings to Steel
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Stringblade[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c] are in [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c] are in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] are full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] becomes available.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] and sends Qingxiao into the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].
After landing from [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].
While in mid-air, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Plunging Attack[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
While out of the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Stringblade[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Sword Glide[/c]
While in mid-air, [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Sword Glide[/c].

skills.name: Severing Note
skills.description:
[c=Title]Severing Note: Judgement[/c]
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. During this skill, gain 45 points of [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c].
While not in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c].
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].

skills.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Tonality Shift
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Casting the skill restores 30 points of [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] and grants [c=Highlight]Resonant Chime[/c].

[c=Title]Resonant Chime[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement[/c] grants 30 points of [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and removes [c=Highlight]Resonant Chime[/c].

skills.name: Lingering Song
skills.description: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 800% of Qingxiao's ATK.

skills.name: Draw and Sunder
skills.description:
Qingxiao inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: For each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target is increased by 1.
Additionally, when the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Qingxiao can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on it. While on the ground and not in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Formless Heart Sword
skills.description:
[c=Title]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
While Qingxiao is in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] become available.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Before [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Before [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available. Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast the skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c] and ends the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mindlock[/c]
[c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target, inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target.
For each stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c].

[c=Title]Heaven's Clarity[/c]
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Billows Beneath Heaven[/c], gain [c=Highlight]Heaven's Clarity[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c]/[c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c] skills deal damage, the rates at which [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c]/[c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], inflict 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on nearby targets, and enhance the next [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] enhancement.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] removes [c=Highlight]Heaven's Clarity[/c].

[c=Title]Swordlight Ward[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tonality Shift[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] grants 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c].
[c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

[c=Title]Sword Flight[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] continuously consumes [c=Highlight]Flight Qi[/c].
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state:
[c=Highlight]Sword Glide[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tonality Shift[/c].
- Exit the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state by:
1. Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c] or [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all [c=Highlight]Flight Qi[/c].

[c=Title]Sword Step[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, hold [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
[c=Highlight]Sword Step[/c] can only be cast once during [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c].

[c=Title]Qin Heart[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c] skills grants [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] cannot be gained while in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Sword Cadence[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c] skills grants [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] cannot be gained while in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Heart Sword Intent[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c].

skills.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
skills.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c].

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] effect, gain [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] with stacks equal to the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks.
If Qingxiao already has [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] and the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks, Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks will be matched to the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks.

[c=Title]Gathered Mind[/c]
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] equal to Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c], if the target has [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c], additionally inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c], and any existing [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] effect becomes inactive.
[c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

skills.name: To Know, To Banish
skills.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c].

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target.

sequences.name: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
sequences.description:
Crit. Rate is increased by 16%.

The max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] is increased to 2. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] additionally grants 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c].

Upon entering combat, gain 25 stacks of [c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c].
After [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade[/c], or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] deals damage, if Qingxiao has [c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c], remove all [c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c] stacks and trigger [c=Highlight]Juque Perdition[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 400% of Qingxiao's ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once per second. For each stack of [c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c] removed, the target takes 4% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Juque Perdition[/c] for 2s.
[c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c] stacks up to 25 times.

sequences.name: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] is increased by 40%.

After entering combat, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on nearby enemies is increased to 25.
The max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] from [c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust[/c] is increased to 25.

[c=Highlight]Heaven's Clarity[/c] is enhanced:
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] now inflicts 6 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on nearby targets.

sequences.name: Dreams Fade, Sword Abides
sequences.description:
The Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c] is increased by 100%.

During [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], gain [c=Highlight]World in Chorus[/c] stacks equal to the highest [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stack count present among nearby enemies.
[c=Highlight]World in Chorus[/c]: Each stack increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] by 3%. [c=Highlight]World in Chorus[/c] is removed after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c].

The [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] effect of [c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust[/c] now inflicts 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].

sequences.name: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
sequences.description: After a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c], their ATK is increased by 20% for 8s.

sequences.name: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement[/c] is increased by 100%.

While moving in [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c], [c=Highlight]Flight Qi[/c] cost is reduced by 30%.

sequences.name: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
sequences.description:
Targets take 40% more DMG from Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c], and [c=Highlight]Juque Perdition[/c].

During [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], gain [c=Highlight]Exorcising Seal[/c] stacks equal to the highest [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stack count present among nearby enemies.

For each stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target, the DMG of [c=Highlight]Juque Perdition[/c] taken by the target is Amplified by 2%. The first 7 stacks additionally grant 5% DMG Amplification.

When [c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish[/c] is unlocked, the DMG of [c=Highlight]Juque Perdition[/c] on targets with [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] is increased by 2% for each stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c]. The first 7 stacks additionally grant 5% DMG increase.

The effect of Qingxiao's response to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Reign of Silence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. 

[c=Title]Rending Lunge[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c].
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c].

[c=Title]Death Snip[/c]
Open the scissors, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] during this skill to deal additional [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Thread Withdrawn[/c].

[c=Title]Thread Withdrawn[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
This skill cannot be cast while in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c]:
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c];
- Cast [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] and press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c].
If interrupted, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c] can be cast again by holding [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

[c=Title]Hanging Finality[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c] to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], after casting this skill, Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] on the ground or use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. This effect is removed when Chisa enters [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Fractured Composition
skills.description:
[c=Title]Eye of Unraveling[/c]
Stagnate and deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] on the ground or use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. This effect is removed when Chisa enters [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Serrated Loop[/c]
While on the ground and [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Serrated Loop[/c].
Stagnate targets, and deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and replaces [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] with [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 1[/c].

skills.name: Moment of Nihility
skills.description:
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. 
Casting this skill sends Chisa into [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c] for 15s.
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c]
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] granted by [c=Highlight]Sawring- Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] when [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].

skills.name: Reverberance - Return
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Unraveling - Law Zero
skills.description:
Grant [c=Highlight]Resonant Thread of Closure[/c] to all nearby Resonators in the team for 20s.
While in [c=Highlight]Resonant Thread of Closure[/c]:
- When an attack hits, increase the max stacks of [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] and [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] the target can receive by 3 for 15s. Unstackable.
- Inflicting [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] or dealing [c=Highlight]Negative Status DMG[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] for 15s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion
skills.description:
[c=Title]Unseen Snare[/c]
Chisa inflicts [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c].
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting [c=Highlight]Serrated Loop[/c].
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Locking[/c] on to a target.
When targets marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

[c=Title]Thread of Bane[/c]
When dealing damage to targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], ignore 18% of their DEF.

[c=Title]Chainsaw Mode[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa unlocks [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] consume [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Sawring - Blitz[/c]
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].  
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to start the combo from [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 1[/c]. Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to start from [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c] to continuously attack the target. [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c] is automatically followed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c], release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button or [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] without directional input to automatically cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c], successful Dodges can be triggered.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to continuously attack the target. [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] is automatically followed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c].
Release [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] to automatically cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] following a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] following [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to sustain the attack. When [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] ends, cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] automatically.
Release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button or [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] without directional input while casting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c] automatically.
[c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] deals [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Sawring - Eradication[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa casts [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] in the following 2 ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after consuming all [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] with [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] or [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c].
Attacking targets with [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Every 1 point of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] consumed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] increases the DMG Multiplier of the next [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c]. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] and ends [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].

[c=Title]Chainsaw Fever[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c].
[c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c] and exits [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa resets [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c], [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c], Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c].

[c=Title]Lifethread - Glide[/c]
When Chisa is not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and has more than 10 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c], she can consume 50 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] in the following 5 ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] in mid-air before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c].
- While in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] or [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] forward shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Thread Withdrawn[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c].
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c].
During the skill, hold [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

[c=Title]Ring of Chainsaw[/c]
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Normal Attack [/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] grants 40 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] grants 20 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].

[c=Title]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c]
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c]. 
Chisa continuously obtains [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] upon defeating a target. 
Exiting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] resets [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] passively for a short period of time after casting  [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c].

Bonus DMG Multiplier per Ring of Chainsaw

skills.name: Inescapable Fate
skills.description: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] is reset, triggered up to once every 3s.

skills.name: All Ends Here
skills.description:
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] grants 20% Havoc DMG Bonus and 20% Healing Bonus for 12s.
When Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] defeat a target marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting 3s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] that lasts for 30s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c].

sequences.name: Wandering Through the Desolate Corridors
sequences.description:
Chisa is immune to interruption during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c],  [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c]

Inflicting [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] grants the following additional effects:
- Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s.
- Deal fixed 61803 points of [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.

sequences.name: Into the Web of Endless Bonds
sequences.description:
Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.
Nearby Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: Across the Confusion of the Long Night
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] are increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].
The bonus DMG Multiplier for [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] granted by [c=Highlight]Sawring- Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] when [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is consumed is increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].
The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Severing the Endless Cycle of Tragic Fate
sequences.description:
The effect of [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] becomes:
When targets marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on them. This effect is triggered up to once every 1s.

sequences.name: Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home
sequences.description:
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] gains 100% DMG Bonus.
[c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] costs 50% less [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c].

sequences.name: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn
sequences.description:
When Chisa takes a fatal blow during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], she will remain standing with at least 1 HP.

[c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c], which has the following effects:
- [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] has all the effects of [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c].
- Targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] takes 30% Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses.
- Targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] takes 40% increased DMG from Chisa.

passive.name: Stormy Resolution
descriptions: Increases Energy Regen by 12.8%. When hitting a target with Resonance Skill, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 10%, lasting for 8s. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 10%, lasting for 8s.

Increases Energy Regen by 16%. When hitting a target with Resonance Skill, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 12.5%, lasting for 8s. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 12.5%, lasting for 8s.

Increases Energy Regen by 19.2%. When hitting a target with Resonance Skill, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 15%, lasting for 8s. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 15%, lasting for 8s.

Increases Energy Regen by 22.4%. When hitting a target with Resonance Skill, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 17.5%, lasting for 8s. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 17.5%, lasting for 8s.

Increases Energy Regen by 25.6%. When hitting a target with Resonance Skill, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 20%, lasting for 8s. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 20%, lasting for 8s.

Glacio DMG + 10%

Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for 15s, which can be triggered once every 25s. While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times.
- Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s.
When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.
ATK + 10%
Inflicting Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on enemies increases the Tune Break Boost of Resonators in the team by 20 for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.
Inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target grants 35% Basic Attack DMG Bonus and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for 15s.
Energy Regen + 10%

Upon inflicting Havoc Bane, gain Xuanling's Feather, which grants a 20% increase in Crit. Rate and 35% increase in Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the Resonator, lasting 15s.
Upon inflicting Glacio Chafe, gain Chongming's Feather, which grants a 0.1% increase in ATK to Resonators in the team for every 1% of the Resonator's Energy Regen, up to 25%, lasting 10s.
Aero DMG + 10%
Inflicting Tune Strain - Shifting increases Crit. DMG by 20% and Aero DMG Bonus 30% for 15s.
Upon gaining a Shield, gain 5% increase in Crit. Rate for 5s, max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered every 0.5s. At max stacks, gain 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.
Electro DMG + 10%
Inflicting Electro Flare on the target, obtaining Unison, or triggering Unison Response increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 15% and grants them 22.5% Electro DMG for 30s.
Electro DMG + 10%

When the Resonator inflicts Electro Flare on enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s.
Healing + 10%

Healing a Resonator in the team increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 10% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked. While the effect is active, if the Resonator gains Unison or triggers Unison Response, their ATK is further increased by 15%.
